text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa! 
……Not yet, I can…… keep going——!
choice_data_list: (She's putting in too much power——)

text_block_list.text:
She's really pushing herself. Her form was starting to crumble and it 
seemed like her legs were pushing forward on sheer willpower alone.
choice_data_list: (What she really needs right now is……)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh! So you came to see me again♪ Do you have any advice? 
I plan on running one more, so after that is fine too——
choice_data_list: You…… should rest. You're working too hard!
You…… should rest. You're working too hard!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
! Ahaa…… you're quite the forgetful trainer, aren't you? I said it 
before, but…… it's fine, I'll tell you as many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I have to keep moving forward. Keep moving, keep thinking, at a 
speed where nobody can keep up…… forward, forward——ever forward!
choice_data_list: ——To become Queen.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Right. Good, you remembered.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And that's why, sorry, but I'm going back to training!
choice_data_list: Then…… all the more reason to rest your wings
Then…… all the more reason to rest your wings

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: …Huh?
choice_data_list: By resting your wings, you can fly higher

text_block_list.text:
A calm mind is the key to peak performance. It serves 
as a foundation to help you climb towards your goal.
choice_data_list: I wanted to give you this
I wanted to give you this

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Is this a gift? If it's given with Heart, 
then it's very welcome, whatever it might be!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Wait——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's a coupon for a reptile cafe, isn't it……!? 
No, well, I like it…… rather I love it!
choice_data_list: And they have a wide variety of reptiles
And they have a wide variety of reptiles

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait a second! 
Just hold on……!
choice_data_list: You can really get to know them

text_block_list.text:
Using the information I researched 
thoroughly, I decided to push harder——!
choice_data_list: They even have some rare species!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Urgh…………——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh my…… I got it, I got it. I give up!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, right now. 
You're stuck with me now! Of course, you're coming with me!

And so, Daring Heart took a break. 
I was glad that my desperate proposal was accepted.
choice_data_list: So you really like reptiles, huh?
So you really like reptiles, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……That's not quite right……『I like reptiles』, 
I've only ever mentioned it once in an old magazine interview.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd find that small article…… 
Fufu…… I just lost to your passion!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Wow……! Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Look at this Green Iguana's scales, they're so shiny……! 
Almost like they're jewels……! So cool……!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And this Ball Python, is really calm isn't it? 
It feels nice and cool to the touch…… Good boy……! This is the best……!

As soon as we arrived at the cafe, Daring Heart's eyes lit up. 
She went around admiring every reptile in the shop.

As I watched over her, a gecko caught my eye. 
It was remaining completely still.
choice_data_list: (Is it sleeping……?)
(Is it sleeping……?)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Putting down roots? 
Don't just stand in the entrance, come and get a closer look♪
choice_data_list: No…… I can see just fine from here!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu…… it's fine, they're not scary at all. 
Come on! Why don't you show me your Daring Heart too?
choice_data_list: (Ugh……)

text_block_list.text:
Steeling my resolve, I reached out towards a Frilled Lizard 
that seemed really docile——and instantly its frills flared out!
choice_data_list: Wah!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You're okay…… don't be afraid. Just touch it calmly and 
it'll be okay. Your kind Heart will definitely reach it……

This time, I stayed calm, trying to convey that I had no 
hostile intentions…… and gently reach out and touch it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nice…… looks like it's enjoying it. 
See, it's not scary at all, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah…… it's kinda cute
Yeah…… it's kinda cute

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu…… Yeah…… it really is.

After enjoying my time with a few more reptiles…… I went back 
and checked on that gecko from earlier. ——It still hadn't moved.
choice_data_list: Has it just been sleeping this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A Leopard Gecko. Part of it is because it's nocturnal but…… 
They tend not to move unnecessarily.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
——CHOMP! Nom, nom, nom…… 
Waiting for that moment to lunge and catch its prey!
choice_data_list: I see. So resting…… to 『Save up』

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Waiting for the right moment, to unleash 
its explosive power……『Saving up』……?)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……『The Correlation Between Relaxation and Explosive Top Speed』?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"While minimizing air resistance, reducing excess motion——and at the 
moment of impact, with an explosive burst of energy. By doing this——"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "This could help cover for any physical disadvantages."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Remaining rigid…… and constantly overextending…… does not make 
an efficient spring. I see, so that's what they meant……)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……this one isn't just remaining still. 
Honing your senses. Waiting for the moment to strike.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If all you do is sharpen your claws, the main course will 
remain out of reach. Yes, that's right…… that's true, for me too……——
choice_data_list: ……a sudden flash of inspiration?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Amazing……! Thanks to that…… I feel like my eyes have been opened!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You…… really are a great trainer! You do have your quirks 
though…… Fufu, things'll never be boring with you around.
choice_data_list: Can you look at this too?
Can you look at this too?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What is it? ……a training menu for the mock race? 
And this is an analysis of Kraft and the others' data…… a schedule……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And it's so detailed…… this must have taken a 
lot of effort, right? Gathering materials and 
analyzing data, it must have taken a lot of time……
choice_data_list: No, not really
No, not really

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And you even researched things I liked……——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You gathered up your courage and stepped in. All for me. 
You're the first person…… who's ever done this much for me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey, I really will…… win that mock race, for sure.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because of you, I feel like I can fly higher. 
More so than when I was alone…… further, and further.
